artworks.title: Diana
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a statue on a pedestal, partially revealed by a figure pulling aside a curtain. Next to the statue, a group of figures with raised arms are shown. The scene includes architectural elements like columns and drapery. The figures are depicted in a classical style, with flowing garments and expressive poses.

artworks.title: Dreaming on Roses
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows an individual lying in a reclining position with their head resting on a pillow. The person's head is slightly tilted to the side and their eyes are closed. They have medium-length, wavy hair. They are wearing a loose-fitting robe-like garment with roses around and on the pillow and clothing. The background has a textured surface.

artworks.title: Idris
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: This image shows two distinct scenes depicted in panels. The upper scene illustrates a figure with wings and a bow, amid a cosmic-like background with foliage and structures. The lower scene features a knight standing beside a horse in a wooded area. A centaur is seen interacting aggressively, a fallen figure lies on the ground, and another character appears to seek assistance or reacts with urgency.

artworks.title: What is the Way to be Happy?
artworks.medium: etching on light blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a lecture or presentation in an academic setting. The scene includes an interior space similar to a lecture hall with detailed illustrations on the walls showing various scientific and anatomical drawings. In the center, a figure stands at a podium gesturing towards the audience, while others in elaborate attire stand to the side. The attendees are seated in rows, facing the speaker. Above the speaker are large posters with German text and scientific illustrations. The artwork emphasizes the scientific and scholarly atmosphere, highlighting a focus on enlightenment and learning.

artworks.title: F.E. von Rochow
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraved portrait of a man in profile wearing a traditional 18th-century coat with decorations and medals on his chest. His hair is styled in an 18th-century manner, with a large curl over the forehead and tied back in a ponytail. The man's expression is serious and contemplative. The name "Friedrich Eberhard von Rochau" is etched into a circular frame surrounding the image. Below the portrait is a decorative element with a relief of a woman with a child and an open book with an inscription. The background of the frame includes intricate engravings on a textured surface.

artworks.title: Rudolph of Hapsburg
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows a medieval battle scene with armored knights on horseback and foot soldiers fighting with swords and spears. Two fallen knights are in the foreground. The background is crowded with soldiers carrying banners and engaged in combat, creating a chaotic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Servants
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows three rows of figures in 18th-century attire. The figures are depicted in various poses, interacting with each other. They have detailed facial features, neatly styled hair, and wear clothing typical of the period, including long coats, waistcoats, stockings, and buckled shoes. Some carry walking sticks, wear powdered wigs, hold letters or documents, and one has a fan. The background is plain, emphasizing the figures. The illustration is created using a stippled and cross-hatched technique.

artworks.title: A Welcome Guest
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered around a table in an indoor setting. The scene depicts multiple figures standing and sitting around a large table which is set for a meal. The central figure is holding a cup. The room has a timber-framed ceiling and paneled walls. The individuals in the scene are wearing historical clothing, likely from the 18th century. A chair with a heart-shaped cutout in the backrest is visible. The figures have expressions of attentiveness on their faces.

artworks.title: A Welcome Guest
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medical scene in a shared sleeping area. The image shows a group of individuals in period clothing standing and gesturing towards others lying in beds. The setting appears to be a rudimentary hospital or dormitory, as indicated by the bare walls and simple bedding. Clothing hangs along the walls, enhancing the spartan appearance of the room. The scene is detailed with fine lines and cross-hatching, giving depth and texture to the drawing. Various expressions and gestures suggest a consultation or discussion among the standing figures, while those in bed appear to be asleep or resting.

artworks.title: Boppart
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Paul Magriel
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a town along a river. The perspective is from the riverbank facing the town, with hills in the background and the town situated between the hills and the river's edge. The horizon is positioned in the upper third of the composition. The lines in the drawing depict the architecture and landscape with precision and without shading. Details of rocks and vegetation are shown near the riverbank, leading to the town's rooftops and towers. The color scheme is monochromatic, with light grey paper and dark pencil lines.

artworks.title: Seville
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Paul Magriel
artworks.description: The drawing shows a view across a body of water with sailboats floating on it. Buildings and a tower are visible on the horizon, suggesting a cityscape. The artist used graphite for delicate strokes detailing the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray on off-white paper. Boats with sailors and birds in flight are included in the composition.

artworks.title: Woman Standing beneath Two Trees
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Paul Magriel
artworks.description: The image is a sketch depicting a wooded environment from a slightly low viewpoint. The trees are shown with twisted trunks and branches extending upwards and outwards, with one dominant tree on the right side. The horizon line is obscured by trees and foliage, with no distinct elements placed directly on it. The sketch uses soft, impressionistic charcoal strokes to convey texture and depth. The color palette is limited to black and gray against a light brown paper, creating a monochromatic effect. Trees in the distance are less defined, blending into the background.

artworks.title: Stowe, Vermont
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Paul Magriel
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a landscape with a horizon positioned towards the bottom. There are tall trees and bushes drawn in detail with textured pencil strokes in the foreground. The composition includes shrubs and branches on the left, two prominent trees in the middle, and rolling hills on the right. The color palette is various shades of gray on beige paper.

artworks.title: John Henderson as Falstaff
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: The image shows a partial full-body view of a person. The individual is leaning back slightly, with one arm extended in a relaxed manner. The face and upper body are detailed, with a neutral expression. The person wears an elaborate costume with a large ruff around the neck. The sketch is outlined, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Old Trees along a Bank
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Ruth and Vernon Taylor Foundation
artworks.description: The image features a serene waterscape with a rowboat and two figures on the left side. A large, gnarled tree in the center of the composition is surrounded by foliage and trunks. The style is naturalistic with soft brushstrokes and fine details, using a monochrome palette of sepia and charcoal. Faint outlines of additional trees are visible in the background.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Village Church
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within platemark): 15.6 x 18.9 cm (6 1/8 x 7 7/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a village scene with a church, houses, trees, hills, and a distant castle-like structure. The style appears to be an etching or early woodcut, using fine line work and intricate detailing. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of sepia or grayscale. Two large trees in the foreground frame the scene, with hills and houses in the distance.

artworks.title: Mr. William Waters
artworks.medium: pastel and graphite with watercolor on two sheets of adhered paper (cut paper silhouette)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a man with a side profile facing right. He has a straight nose, strong jawline, and high forehead. His hair is dark and neatly combed back. He wears a white high-collared shirt under a dark suit. There are no visible accessories or objects in his hand. The background is a muted blue gradient.

artworks.title: Mrs. William Waters
artworks.medium: pastel and graphite with watercolor on four sheets of adhered paper (cut paper silhouette)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a side profile of an upper-body portrait. The subject is facing right with dark brown hair styled in an updo, wearing a small top hat. She has a smooth complexion with rosy cheeks, a delicate nose, and is wearing a dark dress with a white lace collar. A black ribbon is tied around her neck with a watch or pendant attached. She has a white teardrop earring in her ear. The background has a blue-brown gradient.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl with Blue Eyes and Blue Dress
artworks.medium: pastel on two sheets of paper lined wiht
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a young child sitting on a small, red upholstered stool. The child is positioned slightly sideways, facing the viewer's left. They have fair skin, blue eyes, and light blonde hair. The child wears a sky blue dress with a patterned trim, a white lace collar, and a bead necklace. They hold a book in their right hand, resting it on their knee. The background is a muted, neutral tone with a patterned carpet.

artworks.title: Curls and Ruffles
artworks.medium: transparent watercolor and pen and ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 42.5 x 32.6 cm (16 3/4 x 12 13/16 in.)
framed (D): 3 cm (1 3/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a person, depicted in profile, facing left. The person's facial features include large, round eyes with prominent eyebrows, a straight nose, and small, slightly parted lips. The hair is styled in brown, tight curls framing the face, with the rest tied up in an elaborate bun adorned with green leaves and blue floral arrangements. The attire is a formal blue gown with a high collar, intricately detailed with white ruffles that extend downwards in frills. A sheer veil with floral patterns covers the hair and cascades down partly over the shoulders. The background is a plain off-white color.

artworks.title: Feathers and Pearls
artworks.medium: transparent watercolor and pen and ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a person's body. The individual is positioned in a frontal pose with a slight turn to the left. The facial features are distinct, with dark eyebrows and eyes, elongated features, and delicately painted lips. The hair is styled with thick, curling dark locks framed by an ornamental headdress consisting of loops in shades of cream and grey. The clothing is adorned with a decorative design resembling strings of pearls looping across the upper chest on a garment that suggests formality and elegance. The background of the portrait is a soft, neutral beige.

artworks.title: Young Man with Folding Rule
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body. He is facing slightly left, looking at the viewer. He has light skin, blue eyes, dark brown hair styled with mutton chops. He wears a dark blue coat, white shirt with a ruffle, and a white bow tie. He holds a ruler in his right hand. The background is warm-toned with an orange curtain to the left of the man.

artworks.title: Lady with Red and Blue Sewing Bag
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman's upper body. She is seated in a three-quarter pose, facing slightly left, with a soft expression. She has fair skin, expressive eyes, and dark, curly hair styled around her face. She wears a white dress with a lace collar and an embroidered shawl. She holds a blue and orange pouch with a small item sticking out. She accessorizes with small earrings. The background is warm brown with a red draped curtain and a brown book on a ledge.

artworks.title: Bowl of Fruit
artworks.medium: watercolor and stencil on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a vase containing an assortment of different fruits. Notable items include two green apples, a green pear, and a dark green halved watermelon with visible seeds. Surrounding these are cherries, strawberries, blueberries, and grapes. The color scheme includes various shades of green, red, deep blue, and a touch of black against a pale brown background. The fruits are arranged within a bowl placed at the center of the composition, with cherries and leaves extending to the sides, grapes and the watermelon at the top, the apples and pear in the middle, and clusters of blueberries at the bottom.
